inspection.limits: No in-game forest geometry, compositing, readability or acceptance proof. Nonzero alpha reaches three image boundaries.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent 2.5D forest-canopy raster for a Japanese Sengoku strategy game's miniature terrain map. Primary request: a single coherent low woodland group, broad connected overlapping canopy masses with irregular organic forest-edge rhythm, quiet moss/olive green canopy and muted warm soil glimpses, shallow convincing depth. View: high oblique orthographic map view, northwest daylight, restrained soft southeast contact shade, no horizon. Composition: one connected horizontally broad natural woodland group centered with generous truly transparent margins; several broad canopy lobes, sparse small crown detail, irregular inward fading edges. Silhouette must read as a forest group at small map scale, not separate floating tree islands. Style: grounded painterly miniature terrain, realistic organic woodland structure, matte muted surfaces, soft broad light planes rather than sharp black outlines or granular high-contrast noise. This is original art, not copied from any commercial game. Constraints: forest canopy only; no mountains, rocks, castles, houses, roads, rivers, people, flags, UI, labels, text, logo or watermark. No circular stamp border, no solid rectangular backing, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Genuine transparent background and soft alpha at the outer canopy edge.
